correctness.rationale: Completeness reconstructed by classifying (A,B) through u,v,t, identifying unipotent translations of C with the kernel of Hom(Z,X) -> Hom(ker B,X/im A), and proving the stabilizer acts as GL(ker B) x GL(X/im A), hence rank w alone remains. Count subspace pairs via Gaussian intersection q exponent, count injections/surjections and affine fibers; derive ranks N, N² and balanced orbit closed forms from these exact data. The standalone checker independently enumerates 13 finite-field rank histograms and 4 complete parabolic orbits; these are corroboration not general proof. All admissible boundaries and characteristic-two case covered.

originality.rationale: The assessed original statement is the explicit all-dimension four-rank parameterization of FULL parabolic-conjugacy orbits in a three-block nilradical, with Gaussian-product orbit sizes and closed balanced orbit counts. Strong primary papers were compared by implication, not just by title. The 2007 paper already gives finite-orbit theory; 2022 and 2025/2026 papers give stronger marginal Jordan counts, but their published claims do not present the exact four-index P-orbit-size distribution. These known contributions are excluded from the new claim. The residual priority risk of an implicit equivalent classical A3-quiver classification is material but not decisive from examined records.
residual_risks: A general rank-parameter formula for quiver/module orbit sizes might imply this count under a translation not encountered in the inspected 2007 representation theory.
Full Karp–Thomas paper not examined in this run; its abstract supports only the coarse comparison, not proof of absent four-rank refinements.
Search coverage of older non-indexed parabolic/nilpotent matrix orbit enumeration is incomplete; independent historical priority remains unverified.

value.rationale: Computes full labelled parabolic orbit sizes of a canonical finite-field Lie/algebra nilradical in every dimension triple, a natural and finer statistic than known Jordan-type marginal counts. The four-rank structure gives exact conditional independence, a q-independent orbit number and a closed even/odd balanced-level formula. This is a complete natural classification rather than arbitrary small finite sampling. Does not overstate previous finiteness/Jordan results.
